meaning.en: A device that automatically sets compact discs in position for playing in succession, as from a carousel tray or slotted magazine cartridge.

sentences.en: The use of a twist grip gear changer leaves the bars looking much less cluttered.

sentences.en: Within the last several years, I realized that social media was huge - that it's going to be a game changer.
sentences.vi: Trong vài năm qua, tôi nhận ra rằng mạng xã hội là rất lớn - rằng nó sẽ là một người thay đổi cuộc chơi.

sentences.en: These products remind me of the " automatic battery changer " whose sole function was to change its own batteries!

sentences.en: At the bottom is a revolving nosepiece, or as it is sometimes called, the " objective changer " .

sentences.en: Soft metal prevented a satisfactory repair resulting in it breaking again together with the front changer.

sentences.en: Inside, a 6-disc in-dash CD changer with Dolby Pro Logic II surround sound replaces the 4-CD head unit from last year.

sentences.en: This CD changer interface adaptor together with your Alpine CD changer interface adaptor together with your Alpine CD changer will produce superior sounding results.

sentences.en: Are you a career changer, job seeker, student, or someone just looking for a better life?
sentences.vi: Bạn là người thay đổi nghề nghiệp, người đang tìm việc, sinh viên hay một người chỉ muốn tìm kiếm một cuộc sống tốt đẹp hơn?

sentences.en: Try touching the aerial onto the grid of the frequency changer on the affected band.

sentences.en: Each column is highlighted by its own Martin Architectural Exterior 200 color changer.
